why: R7.5 D4c's THIRD READING, which is a TARGET and not a verdict. `[deadline].instants` names it, so the engine lands a step one tick before this instant, on it, and one tick past it -- and those landings are the only way a walk arrives in the hour where the application's arithmetic and the zone's own midnight disagree. The value here is 2026-03-09T01:00:00-05:00, which is what the toy computes as the next reset on the 23-hour day: an hour LATE. THIS CASE DOES NOT JUDGE THAT. Whether a reset instant is right depends on where it falls in the zone's day and rego has no database to read it with, so the verdict belongs to `invite_quota_reset`'s clock face and this clause asks only that an instant was reported at all.
